# Industrial Forecasting #061–#070 — Reproducible Time Series Experiments

**All data are synthetic, generated by deterministic formulas.** This is not genuine industrial telemetry, commodity/FX price history, official ESG readings, ERP data, or validated predictive accuracy.

## Scope & stack

All ten projects run **Pandas, NumPy, Statsmodels ExponentialSmoothing (ETS), Meta Prophet (trained with .fit/.predict), and Plotly** in executable Python code. Each project has a unique weekly synthetic outcome, scale, trend and seasonal behavior defined in \`config.json\`.

| Project | Synthetic outcome | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| 061 | Steel and alloy input prices | BRL/tonne |
| 062 | S&OP billed sales | BRL/week |
| 063 | Facility thermal load, not a weather service | kWh_thermal/week |
| 064 | Rolling mill electric demand | MWh/week |
| 065 | IIoT broker API traffic | messages/week |
| 066 | Tooling/industrial control supplies | units/week |
| 067 | Machining center & dock capacity occupation | percent_occupancy |
| 068 | **FX volatility**, not FX price | percent_weekly_realized_volatility |
| 069 | Facility emissions | tCO2e/week |
| 070 | Plant consumables burn-rate | litres/week |

## Reproducible temporal methodology

- 240 observations starting **2021-01-04**, once a week (Monday).
- **Expanding-window validation** origins at row counts 168, 192, and 216, each predicting the following 8 weekly observations. Validation dates are strictly later than corresponding train dates.
- **Final untouched test** is the last 8 weeks (rows 232–239). No training or hyperparameter choice uses those target values.
- Seasonal-naive benchmark repeating the last 13 weekly values.
- Statsmodels **ETS (damped additive trend, additive seasonal period=13)** fitted afresh on every training window.
- Model **selection** uses lower validation MAE across seasonal naive and ETS. Prophet is fitted separately only on final-training data, evaluated on the untouched test, **never chosen based on test performance**. Prophet's year-level seasonal component is an independent diagnostic.
- **Metrics** include MAE, RMSE, WAPE, MAPE (epsilon-protected denominator) and sMAPE. These apply exclusively to artificial observations.
- **Intervals:** empirical errors from 3 limited validation windows and Prophet uncalibrated model intervals. Coverage is descriptive and **not** a guarantee.
- Future prediction \`--future\` trains on the complete 240-week artificial history and forecasts the **next 8 unobserved weeks**. No accuracy metric exists for future predictions.

## Commands

\`\`\`bash
python -m pip install -r requirements-timeseries.txt
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_timeseries_batch.py -v

# Run one case (unseen holdout).
python -m timeseries_batch.engine 61 --save
python projetos/07-timeseries/061-steel-alloy-commodity-forecasting/main.py --save

# Forecast eight future simulated weeks.
python -m timeseries_batch.engine 61 --future --save

# Execute all ten cases and export evidence files.
for id in $(seq 61 70); do python -m timeseries_batch.engine "$id" --save; done
\`\`\`

## Evidence artifacts

- \`data/{id}.csv\`: generated 240-row artificial weekly series, with provenance.
- \`reports/{id}.json\`: out-of-time metrics, 3 folds, test values and forecasts.
- \`reports/{id}_predictions.csv\`: eight held-out forecasts and nominal intervals.
- \`reports/{id}_future.json\`: eight future dates and values, no observed outcomes.
- \`figures/{id}.html\`: interactive self-contained Plotly diagnostics.
- CI uploads exports as GitHub Actions artifacts.

All outputs are generated at runtime; they are not misleading static business KPIs.

## Exclusions & threats to validity

No official FX series, weather feed, financial quotes, emission meters, machine sensors or company orders were used. The synthetic generation mechanism is known and therefore represents an **easier-than-real** learning problem. Periodic seasonality is simplified; regime breaks, zeros, rare events, holidays, abrupt supply shocks, contractual terms and changing measurement practices are not validated. Models may converge differently with new dependencies. Real use requires licensed observations, quality checks, proper feature availability, legal data governance, additional rolling-origin evaluation, uncertainty recalibration, service/monitoring, domain sign-off and stakeholder approval. No 100/100 portfolio certification or actual monetary savings is claimed.

The existing case_studies forecasting study remains a separate earlier demonstrative analysis; project #061 now has its own domain-specific entrypoint.
